title: Uttarakhand ERO refused BJP worker’s bulk Form 7 objections. After ECI complaint, 5,359 were accepted
shows: It follows the Form 7 objections in Kichha, Uttarakhand, from the Chief Electoral Officer's Form 10 data to the final roll of 3 October. Of 4,390 names on the draft that are missing from the final roll, about 670 had an objection against them and 3,720 had none and were deleted for logical discrepancies. One BJP booth level agent filed 5,359 of the 6,884 objections accepted, and 504 of his carry an acceptance date a day after claims closed. A second part meets electors deleted after his objections whose notices gave other reasons.
quote: Of the 4,390 names missing from Kichha’s final electoral roll, 3,720 had no objections filed against them.

title: यूपी में एसआईआर की जिन गड़बड़ियों को लेकर चुनाव आयोग है निशाने पर
shows: It sets out what is known of the Pilibhit Sadar case, from the Congress's allegation of 13,150 changed names to the Chief Electoral Officer's note of 22 October on 13,779 Form 8 entries with no records behind them. BBC Hindi checked rolls itself and found two electors at one polling station in Bareilly each entered under two EPIC numbers, and one elector in Pilibhit Sadar entered under three. It could not reach Pilibhit's Deputy District Election Officer for comment. It also recounts the Samajwadi Party's complaint of duplicates and the Chief Electoral Officer's instruction of 19 October to delete them through Form 7.
quote: इस दौरान हमें भी ऐसे कई उदाहरण मिले, जिनमें एक ही नाम और उससे संबंधित डीटेल अलग-अलग ईपीआईसी नंबरों पर दर्ज था.
note: Read in full from the page's paragraphs with curl on 25 October 2026. Published 24 October 2026, 10:09 am IST, from Lucknow, published for the BBC by Collective Newsroom. BBC Hindi says it holds the EPIC numbers and does not publish them. The disputes page carries the Pilibhit case as up-21 and up-22.
